device.description: 8-bit serial-output SAR ADC with one differential input (ADC0831 compatible)
device.note: slas107b.pdf (SLAS107B) p.1 pinouts (D/P packages), p.3 functional description (CS, MUX settling clock, start bit, DI disabled during conversion, LSB-first data on TLC0832), p.4 sequence of operation and MUX-address control logic table, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.7 operating characteristics (tpd, tdis, tconv)

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3 (functional description), p.4 (sequence of operation), p.5 (recommended operating conditions), p.7 (operating characteristics)
notModeled: p.4: DO is Hi-Z until the first CLK falling edge after CS falls, then the MUX-settling low, then D7..D0 MSB first on the following falling edges; the model shifts z, 0, D7..D0 (mode 0)
after the LSB the datasheet does not show the DO level for the TLC0831 (no LSB-first data on it); the model drives 0 until CS rises
analog input(s) and the REF span (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00); a negative differential input reads 0x00
the conversion is clocked by CLK (8 clock periods after the MUX settling clock, p.7 tconv); not timed, the result is the 0 V code at once
fCLK 10-600 kHz, 40-60 % duty cycle, tsu 350 ns / th 90 ns, CS high 220 ns min (p.5)
tpd is 1500 ns max MSB-first and 600 ns LSB-first (CL = 100 pF); the model uses 1500 ns for every bit
tdis (CS high to DO Z) is 250 ns max at CL = 10 pF and 500 ns at CL = 100 pF; the model uses 250 ns
all internal registers are cleared when CS goes high; a new conversion needs a CS high-to-low transition (p.3)
variants: TLC0832 (same datasheet): 2-channel MUX with DI address input, LSB-first data after MSB-first; separate device TLC0832.
